```sql
WITH tenant_customers AS (
    SELECT c.id
      FROM customers c
     WHERE c.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
),
customer_stats AS (
    SELECT o.customer_id,
           sum(o.total_cents) AS revenue,
           count(*)           AS order_count,
           max(o.created_at)  AS last_order_at
      FROM orders o
      JOIN tenant_customers tc ON tc.id = o.customer_id
     WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
     GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT c.id,
       c.email,
       c.company,
       c.country_code,
       cs.revenue,
       cs.order_count,
       cs.last_order_at
  FROM customer_stats cs
  JOIN customers c ON c.id = cs.customer_id
 WHERE cs.last_order_at >= %(from)s
   AND cs.last_order_at <  %(to)s
 ORDER BY cs.revenue DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De tenantfilter wordt naar beneden gehaald naar de orders, zodat er niet meer alle orders van alle tenants worden gescand, en de DISTINCT ON-sortering is vervangen door een `max(created_at)` in dezelfde aggregatie. Het resultaat blijft gelijk, al is de volgorde van rijen met gelijke omzet, net als in het origineel, niet gedefinieerd.
